//: Test-runner config. Tests live in tests/ rather than src/ on purpose: apps/web, apps/admin and apps/mobile all glob ../../packages/shared/src straight into their own tsconfig include, so a *.test.ts under src/ would drag Node built-ins (assert, process) into three browser builds that have no @types/node. Also pinned to CommonJS because ts-node needs it while the package ships as ESNext/bundler for Vite and Metro.
